_source: Enemy.vb. Screen units, per frame. maxEnemy 13 is 14 enemies; mass is massBase + massRandom x rand. loadHP is loadEnemy's, resetHP Root.vb Reset's (every wave is a reset's). cautiousSeekMultiple is the Cautious state's 6 x seekSpd.

port._about: Not in the original. radius is world units, never mapped. seekCap is how many enemies may Seek at once: 14, every one, as Enemy.vb loadEnemy, Root.vb Reset and the Hurt recovery set Seek for all (BIBLE D18, settled by U.CHN-T81). A lower cap is UNI-T65's hang-back, kept only as a data option (spike U.CHN-T90): the rest wait in Cautious or Align. hangBackNear and hangBackFar (screen units, mapped by space.json) are the band waiting enemies hold: Align stalks in to the near edge, one angel width (angelSize 0.3) out, and Cautious backs off to the far edge, half as far again.
